SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstractGood, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstractBad FROM abstract_record WHERE del_flag = 0
AND create_time >= #{begin}
AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY statDate ORDER BY statDate
